title: .respawnpack/runtime/stop-<sessionId>.json — the record that ends the Stop loop
description: Written by hooks/_runtime.js recordStop() from hooks/stop-savepoint.js. GITIGNORED. ⛔ THE FINGERPRINT IS THE MECHANISM (Scenario J): keying on (session, HEAD, delta digest) is what lets a SECOND unchanged stop be accepted instead of blocking forever, which is the R-8 loop. `fingerprint` is the only field alreadyStoppedOn() reads; the rest exist so a human can tell what was blocked and why.
